Shop Dave’s Garage 912 Comments Sort comments Sort by Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Add a comment... @Chris-hf2sl 9 months ago I'm a retired electronic engineer, who spent a whole career designing, programming and using computers. I've watched many videos on quantum computers and am still none the wiser on how they actually work. All the videos cover the same basic principles - qubits, superposition, entanglement, being all states at once etc. BUT none explain how to program them or how they execute algorithms. I'm in the same position as a complete layman who is trying to understand how conventional computers work, only to be repeatedly told "they use bits that can be 0 or 1, which are processed by logic gates and which in large numbers can represent anything". Yes, but how do they actually work?
